summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.total: sums the tenant's approved entries and rounds to 2 dp with MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero (RQ-FXL-0003, DF-FXL-0007). Existing balance tests unchanged.

criteria.criterion: Approved 0.005 alone totals 0.01; approved -0.005 alone totals -0.01
criteria.test: total rounds a half cent away from zero

criteria.criterion: Unapproved entries and other tenants' entries do not count
criteria.test: total ignores unapproved and other tenants' entries

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.approve using FxIdentity.Identity.isActive and hasRole Approver, checking in the RQ-FXL-0004 order: SessionExpired, NotAuthorized, NotFound (tenant-scoped), SelfApproval, AlreadyApproved. On success sets Approved and ApprovedBy only. fx-identity was not modified.

criteria.criterion: A session idle for exactly 15 minutes can approve
criteria.test: approve succeeds for an Approver idle exactly 15 minutes

criteria.criterion: At 15 minutes 1 second the session gets SessionExpired
criteria.test: approve rejects a session idle 15 minutes and 1 second

criteria.criterion: An Admin without Approver gets NotAuthorized
criteria.test: approve rejects an Admin without the Approver role

criteria.criterion: An entry of another tenant is reported as NotFound, never NotAuthorized
criteria.test: approve reports another tenant's entry as NotFound

criteria.criterion: Self-approval is rejected with SelfApproval and re-approval with AlreadyApproved

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.view: returns SessionExpired when the session is not active (isActive), otherwise the session tenant's entries in original order. No role, including Admin, widens scope (RQ-FXL-0006, DF-FXL-0005). The superseded DF-FXL-0002 was not followed.

criteria.criterion: An Admin of t1 sees only t1 entries, in original order
criteria.test: view returns only the session tenant's entries even for an Admin

summary: Not implemented. RQ-FXL-0008 (currency conversion) is only proposed and depends on DF-FXL-0009, which is still a draft: the exchange-rate source is undecided and the ledger has no rates. Rounding and the rate date are not specified, so any conversion would be invented behaviour. convertCurrency remains a stub. Unblock by accepting DF-FXL-0009 and specifying RQ-FXL-0008 acceptance criteria.

criteria.criterion: Amounts are convertible between ISO 4217 currencies using the accepted rates source (DF-FXL-0009)
Rounding and the rate date for conversion are specified and applied
